answer: Require each identity to lock 160 POA for 56 epochs and complete thirteen unpredictable jobs per round, with a 12-of-21 established jury signing replayable receipts. One missed round freezes rewards; two slash 85% of the pearl bond. Funding-linked entrants cross an oasis where every new bond doubles, making clone costs geometric. The ledger verifies task hashes, quorum signatures, timestamps, and funding ancestry; each related vertex inherits the higher tier.
